Name: Submerged Arc Welding open repository
Summary: Process data, experiment design and non-destructive testing results from test coupons welded by submerged arc welding by AIMEN.
Publisher: AIMEN (Asociación de Investigación Metalúrgica del Noroeste)
Description:
The Submerged Arc Welding open repository is a dataset from AIMEN, the Asociación de Investigación Metalúrgica del Noroeste, collected within the ZDZW project. It gathers data from a series of test coupons welded with the submerged arc welding (SAW) process.

The repository covers the whole manufacturing workflow rather than the welding signals alone: the process data, the design of the experiment with its process window parameterisation, and non-destructive testing (NDT) data. Everything ships as a single ZIP archive, with a README that explains how to open each file type with open software.

The authors frame it against the need for quality control and early defect detection in SAW, as a foundation for data-driven methods and process optimisation. It was published in 2025 under CC BY 4.0.
